The problem is when a scene or character could never happen without relying on CGI and most if not all of the visual FX companies underbid on contracts because if they don't get work they'd starve and usually lose money because their bid is as low as possible without any room to actually grow. Background

One Dreamworlds-related thing I love is the fact that there are multiple Youtube channels dedicated to showcasing music across many subgenres of the electronic genre; channels like Ambient, Fluidified, MrReindeerMusic, MrSuicideSheep, Pretend Penguin, Welcome Home Music, xKito Music are all examples of this. A wonderful trend I've grown accustom to overtime has been their tendencies to pick beautiful, usually otherworldly background pictures for their uploads. Stack those otherworldly pictures on top of the fact that a lot of the music they feature is otherworldly and what we have is something that's perfect for /v/Dreamworlds. As you may have picked up on, I get most of my music uploads to this subverse from these music channels. Whenever I upload a song, or somebody else uploads a song, I add said song to a Youtube playlist and a SoundCloud playlist if it applies.

The Idea

I was at work today listening to my Dreamworlds Music playlist on Youtube and I had a thought. Why not put all of the best uploads in a playlist then, at the end of the year, make the playlist public and share it with everybody, start a new playlist for the coming year, and make it an annual thing?

Let me know what ya think.
